requirements.candidate_label: Cover conflicting intersection devices in a closed directional roadway
requirements.subject: Existing WRONG WAY signs, markings, and other conflicting traffic-control devices at intersections within the closed directional roadway
requirements.relation: shall be covered, removed, or obliterated
requirements.threshold: No inapplicable conflicting device remains exposed within the temporary closure/intersection area
applicability_conditions: An intersection lies within the temporary two-lane/two-way operations or closure area
required_inputs: Field inventory of existing intersection traffic-control devices
requirements.source_span: When a directional roadway is closed, inapplicable WRONG WAY signs and markings, and other existing traffic control devices at intersections within the temporary two-lane, two-way operations section shall be covered, removed, or obliterated.

requirements.subject: The ROAD (STREET) WORK (W20-1) sign (see Figure 6H-1), which serves as a general warning of obstructions or restrictions,

requirements.candidate_label: TABLE-6B-1 table: advance warning sign dimensions A, B, and C
requirements.subject: advance warning sign dimensions A, B, and C
requirements.threshold: Urban low speed: A=100 ft, B=100 ft, C=100 ft; urban high speed: A=350 ft, B=350 ft, C=350 ft; rural: A=500 ft, B=500 ft, C=500 ft; expressway/freeway: A=1,000 ft, B=1,500 ft, C=2,640 ft. A is restriction-to-first-sign distance, B first-to-second, and C second-to-third.
applicability_conditions: road type and agency-determined speed category
requirements.source_span: Table 6B-1. Recommended Advance Warning Sign Minimum Spacing. Urban (low speed): 100 feet, 100 feet, 100 feet. Urban (high speed): 350 feet, 350 feet, 350 feet. Rural: 500 feet, 500 feet, 500 feet. Expressway / Freeway: 1,000 feet, 1,500 feet, 2,640 feet. The column headings A, B, and C are the dimensions shown in Figures 6P-1 through 6P-54.

measurement_spec.quantity: spacing between successive advance warning signs

thresholds.condition: urban low-speed advance warning sign spacing

requirements.candidate_label: SEC-6H.02 02: Where multiple advance warning signs are needed on the approach to a transition and activity area, the ROAD WORK AHEAD (
requirements.subject: Where multiple advance warning signs are needed on the approach to a transition and activity area, the ROAD WORK AHEAD (W20-1) sign
requirements.threshold: Where multiple advance warning signs are needed on the approach to a transition and activity area, the ROAD WORK AHEAD (W20-1) sign should be the first advance warning sign encountered by road users.
requirements.source_span: Where multiple advance warning signs are needed on the approach to a transition and activity area, the ROAD WORK AHEAD (W20-1) sign should be the first advance warning sign encountered by road users.

requirements.candidate_label: SEC-6H.02 01: Where highway conditions permit, warning signs
requirements.subject: Where highway conditions permit, warning signs
requirements.threshold: Where highway conditions permit, warning signs should be placed in advance of the transition and activity areas at varying distances depending on roadway type, condition, and posted speed. Table 6B-1 contains information regarding the spacing of advance warning signs. Where a series of two or more advance warning signs is used, the closest sign to the transition and activity areas should be placed approximately 100 feet for low-speed urban streets to 1,000 feet or more for freeways and expressways.
requirements.source_span: Where highway conditions permit, warning signs should be placed in advance of the transition and activity areas at varying distances depending on roadway type, condition, and posted speed. Table 6B-1 contains information regarding the spacing of advance warning signs. Where a series of two or more advance warning signs is used, the closest sign to the transition and activity areas should be placed approximately 100 feet for low-speed urban streets to 1,000 feet or more for freeways and expressways.

measurement_spec.quantity: longitudinal distance from the closest advance-warning sign to the transition/activity area
